title: A case of the Ferret passkey matrix
description: extension/test/fixtures/passkey/<id>/case.json. The pages are served by the fixture container (test/passkey-rp); the runner is extension/test/firefox/passkeyMatrix.mjs, the checks of this file are caseProblems() in passkeyCases.mjs.

id.description: Equal to the name of the folder.

client.description: swa: @simplewebauthn/browser; manual: webauthn-json style; pubkey: manual, and reads getPublicKey()

page.description: chain: the hosts from the top page to the page that runs the ceremony, kinds[i]: how chain[i] frames chain[i+1]; allow[i]: its allow attribute. A demo case has page.url instead.

items.description: one of rp-a.test, login.rp-a.test, rp-b.test, attacker.test, vault-fixture.test, user.github.io, evil.github.io, xn--rp--8cd.test, localhost (any letter case, with or without a trailing dot)

spec.description: What the ceremony page does: see the top of test/passkey-rp/pages/lib.mjs (steps, rpId, user, create, get, holdMs, tamper). The adversarial pages are named in __page.

gesture.description: click: a real click on the page's #go button; none: the page starts at once (?auto=1) with no user activation

route.description: ferret: Ferret answered (its window was shown); browser: the original call answered; none: nothing answered; any: either is fine

flags.description: uv, be, bs as the relying party read them

adv.description: checks of what an adversarial page reported: { key, equals } or { key, noValue }

stub.description: the same members, where the browser path (the stub provider) must answer differently from Ferret

unsafe.description: what an unsafe answer is for this case: { id (one of the unsafe ids of categories.json), definition }

needs.description: the case can only be judged with Ferret answering: the stub provider cannot run it, and it counts as not run

waitMs.description: how long the runner waits for the page's report (default 20000)

actions.description: what the runner does besides the click, for cases with needs provider: [{ do: ... }]
